figures.alt: Painted portrait of Giorgio Vasari: a bearded man in dark clothes with a gold chain, against a dark background.
figures.caption: Fig. 1. Attributed to Jacopo Zucchi, Portrait of Giorgio Vasari (formerly considered a self-portrait), 1571–74, oil on canvas. Florence, Gallerie degli Uffizi, [inv. 00021975]. Courtesy of the Ministero della Cultura – Gallerie degli Uffizi.

figures.alt: Painted full-length portrait of Dong Qichang standing in a long robe with a scholar's hat.
figures.caption: Fig. 2. Xu Zhang (1694–1749), posthumous portrait of Dong Qichang, from the album Songjiang bangyan huaxiang (Portraits of Eminent Men of Songjiang), 18th century, ink and colour on paper. Nanjing Museum.

figures.alt: Chinese hanging scroll in ink on silk showing tall rounded mountains, forests and a winding path.
figures.caption: Fig. 3. Attributed to Juran, Seeking the Tao in Autumn Mountains, Five Dynasties–Northern Song, late 10th century, hanging scroll, ink on silk, 156.2 × 77.2 cm. Taipei, National Palace Museum, inv. Guhua 000021. Open Data, CC BY 4.0.

figures.alt: Chinese hanging scroll Early Spring by Guo Xi: towering rocky mountains with twisted trees and mist.
figures.caption: Fig. 4. Guo Xi, Early Spring, 1072, hanging scroll, ink and light colour on silk, 158.3 × 108.1 cm. Taipei, National Palace Museum, inv. Guhua 000053. Open Data, CC BY 4.0.

figures.alt: Round Chinese album leaf in ink on silk: a scholar on a riverbank watching clouds rise over distant hills.
figures.caption: Fig. 5. Ma Lin, Scholar Reclining and Watching Rising Clouds (poem by Wang Wei), c. 1256, album leaf, ink on silk, 25.1 × 25.3 cm. Cleveland Museum of Art, 1961.421, John L. Severance Fund. Public domain (CC0).

figures.alt: Raphael's fresco The Disputation of the Holy Sacrament: heavenly figures on clouds above a gathering of theologians around an altar.
figures.caption: Fig. 6. Raphael, Disputation of the Holy Sacrament (Disputa del Sacramento), 1509–10, fresco. Vatican City, Apostolic Palace, Stanza della Segnatura. Photo © Governatorato SCV – Direzione dei Musei.

figures.alt: Chinese handscroll with groups of women playing music in a palace garden, followed by an enlarged detail of the same scene.
figures.caption: Fig. 7. Attributed to Zhou Wenju, United by Music, Ming dynasty (15th–16th century). Art Institute of Chicago, 1950.1370 (CC0). Below, detail.

extra.alt: Enlarged detail of the same handscroll.

figures.alt: Masaccio's fresco of the Holy Trinity: Christ on the cross under a coffered barrel vault, with figures kneeling in front.
figures.caption: Fig. 8. Masaccio, Holy Trinity, c. 1425–1427. Fresco, 667 × 317 cm. Florence, Santa Maria Novella. Public domain via Wikimedia Commons.

figures.alt: Detail of the Chinese handscroll Along the River During the Qingming Festival: an arched bridge crowded with people and boats.
figures.caption: Fig. 9. Zhang Zeduan, Along the River During the Qingming Festival, Northern Song dynasty, early 12th century, detail. Handscroll, ink and colours on silk, 24.8 × 528.7 cm. Palace Museum, Beijing. Public domain (PD-Art), via Wikimedia Commons.

figures.alt: Detail of Lorenzetti's fresco of Good Government: a busy city with towers, houses and people in the streets.
figures.caption: Fig. 10. Ambrogio Lorenzetti, Effects of Good Government in the City and Countryside, 1338–1339, detail of the city. Fresco. Siena, Palazzo Pubblico, Sala dei Nove. Courtesy of Comune di Siena – Museo Civico. Public domain (Google Art Project, via Wikimedia Commons).

figures.alt: Fra Angelico's Annunciation: the angel and the Virgin facing each other under a vaulted loggia with slender columns.
figures.caption: Fig. 11. Fra Angelico, Annunciation, c. 1440–1445. Fresco, 230 × 321 cm. Florence, Museo di San Marco, north corridor. By permission of the Ministero della Cultura – Direzione regionale Musei nazionali Toscana. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

figures.alt: Piero della Francesca's Flagellation of Christ: the scene in a classical hall on the left and three men standing in the foreground on the right.
figures.caption: Fig. 12. Piero della Francesca, The Flagellation of Christ, c. 1459–1460. Tempera on poplar panel, 58.4 × 81.5 cm. Urbino, Galleria Nazionale delle Marche (Palazzo Ducale), inv. DE 229. By permission of the Ministero della Cultura – Galleria Nazionale delle Marche. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.
